rules.name: Phishing Link Detection
rules.description: Detect credential harvesting links in email via URL reputation
rules.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "phishing" or CommandLine contains "link" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-INITIAL_ACCESS-127
